mode: Signed transactions submitted to a compiled-validator emulator. Counterparty checkpoints and initial deployment are authenticated fixture pre-state
scope: Current-main signed compiled-validator Cardano packet and client costs. Permanent authenticated ICS-20 receipt history removes routine lane pruning and its proof updates. The retained September 9, 2026 fee snapshot isolates code changes. Existing deployment is assumed. Injective and idle resource measurements remain dated historical evidence
rounding: Recurring components are rounded up independently to whole lovelace. Transaction balances reconcile exactly before averaging.
walletSelection: Generated fixture keys and change selection can cause small variations between runs. Collateral is reported as reserved capital, not an expense.

clientUpdates.scope: Same captured signed 45-validator unchanged header and retained fee parameters. The general controls deliberately retain trusted-set reconstruction. No production eligibility or update frequency is inferred. Each profile is one cold complete update rather than a warmed mean
clientUpdates.coordinationAttribution: Shared in-flight and accepted exact-height work can avoid redundant preparation. These runs do not measure paid duplicate updates or worker CPU/RSS, so no additional monetary saving is assigned
clientUpdates.cadenceModel: 100 receive proof heights plus 100 acknowledgement heights in the singleton example. Ready pairs use 100 receive heights plus 50 acknowledgement heights. No pruning updates or idle refreshes. No collection timer or production pairing/churn rate is inferred
